biggest_catch: REJECT — the company is real (Prodege LLC, operator of Swagbucks), but Swagbucks' own official pages publish no concrete payout figures for this games route: no SB-to-dollar conversion, no per-game payout, and no redemption minimum. The catalog's '$10' headline is not an official figure, and the commonly cited 100 SB = $1 / $5 PayPal minimum comes only from third-party sources.
catches: Official help articles confirm 'Play games. Have fun with online Games and earn SB while you play' and that SB is 'redeemed for gift cards or cash' — but publish no SB→$ conversion rate, no per-game payout, and no redemption minimum.
The headline figure of $10 per game is not an official Swagbucks figure; third-party reviews describe game offers paying roughly $4–$12 per game over weeks of play.
100 SB = $1 and a $5 (500 SB) PayPal minimum are widely reported by third parties but not stated on the official help pages obtained.
No upfront fee; free sign-up via the official help center's earn pages.
